_comment: MCP resource spec for #24 OKR Critique. Phase 2 .mcpb bundle target. Draft 2026-05-17.

_app.name: OKR Critique
_app.type: paste + LLM critique with stance picker

resource.name: OKR Critique
resource.description: Paste draft OKRs. Returns four-test critique per KR (outcome-vs-activity, measurable, single-team-fit, too-many), stance-specific synthesis, and a rewritten set.

tools.name: okr_parse
tools.description: Deterministic. Extracts objectives and key results from free-form pasted text. Returns structured form for downstream critique.

tools.name: okr_critique
tools.description: LLM-narrated. Runs four-test critique per KR (outcome-vs-activity, measurable, single-team-fit, too-many), produces per-KR diagnosis + rewrite + anchor.

tools.name: okr_org_coherence
tools.description: LLM-narrated. Org-level cross-team coherence check across multiple objectives. Surfaces internal contradictions and KR-ownership ambiguity.
tools._phase_note: Available in both web and MCP versions, but only triggered when level == 'org'.

tools.name: okr_mortality
tools.description: MCP-only (stateful). Ingests actual quarterly outcomes after the fact. Surfaces which OKRs were rewritten mid-quarter vs achieved as-stated. Pattern: high mid-quarter rewrites = theatre.
tools._phase_note: Web version does not expose this. Mortality analysis requires persisted prior OKRs + outcomes, which is .mcpb scope.

_open_questions: Validate ui:// URI scheme against current MCP Apps spec.
Org-level coherence: what's the right max-objectives input cap? More than 8 starts to read as 'we're doing too many things' rather than a coherence problem.
okr_mortality: should the tool prompt the user for outcomes per KR, or pull from connected analytics? Latter is a hard dependency.
Should the four-test verdicts be configurable (some teams reject 'too-many' as a test) or locked? Locked is simpler; configurable is closer to how teams actually argue about OKRs.
